checks: The fixed contact indicator and inward selectors are independent of the mixture. The uniform cut-mixture theorem supplies the actual first losses, and Fubini gives their exact probability averages. Joint continuity of the fields on the compact domain makes each response continuous.

The compact generating image has compact convex hull. The expectation of any mixture belongs to it by separation; conversely any convex combination is a physical field mixture with the same prescribed ceiling.

Carathéodory in dimension m gives m+1 fields for signed vectors, and in dimension m+1 gives m+2 for the full cost/capture vector. The finite vector hull and translated open orthant separate. Every coefficient of an appropriately oriented separator is nonnegative, and its normalized infimum on the orthant is exactly the best guaranteed value.

The reverse bound follows from an attaining hull vector whose every coordinate is at least that value. The maximum over Θ is continuous in the weight vector, so pointwise strict positivity on its compact probability simplex is equivalent to a strictly positive minimum. Source 4c4db2dc9830c76a §5 (14)–(16) agrees.
